prompt: Complete two reviewer-owned unfamiliar interview loops for materially different SRE, DevOps, platform, infrastructure or architecture roles. The reviewer controls job descriptions, time limits, question selection and follow-up changes. Use only learner-owned policy-safe evidence. Do not use published model answers, employer-confidential material, fabricated claims, hiring predictions or unauthorized live assistance.
deliverables: Versioned role requirement and level-signal map for both loops
Evidence inventory separating learner-owned artifacts, permitted experience, qualified recollection, unknowns and gaps
Canonical story bank covering ownership, failure, disagreement, influence, incident, automation, security, capacity/cost, mentoring and architecture
Claim ledger with source, window, unit, authority, contribution, confidentiality, confidence and limitation
Thirty-second, two-minute, five-minute and fifteen-minute variants derived from the same facts
Direct answers to behavioral, incident, project and architecture questions
Clarifying questions and assumptions for ambiguous technical prompts
At least twelve reviewer-controlled changing follow-ups
One explicit correction after the reviewer challenges a weak or unsupported claim
Incident defense with impact, evidence, role, action control, communication, recovery and learning
Architecture defense with requirements, units, state, failure, security, operations, alternatives and evolution
Truthful resume-project defense linking every material claim to available evidence
AI and confidentiality audit showing no prohibited input or live assistance
Reviewer scorecards for both loops and a revised evidence bank
Delayed follow-up mock using a different question order and constraints
evidenceRequirements: Use only learner-owned, public, authorized or reviewer-created fictional material
No employer secret, customer data, private message, employee record, vulnerability, credential or production endpoint
No fabricated metric, title, authority, team size, scope, sentiment, outcome or causality
Every quantitative claim includes source, baseline, unit, window, exclusions and uncertainty where applicable
Personal actions are distinguishable from team work and decision authority held by others
Job requirements are mapped from the actual versioned role rather than a generic company stereotype
All duration variants preserve canonical facts
Failure stories retain actual adverse consequence and do not become disguised success stories
Incident hypotheses remain distinct from observed facts and later causal analysis
Architecture reasoning includes requirements, units, state, failure, security, operations and trade-offs
Changing follow-ups do not produce contradiction or newly invented facts
Unsupported claims are corrected or withdrawn during the defense
AI use is limited to explicitly allowed preparation with safe data and human verification
No live interview assistance unless the interviewer explicitly authorizes it
Reviewer controls question secrecy, scoring, hidden changes, timing, follow-up and delayed recall

rubric.observableEvidence: Answers target versioned competencies and distinguish required, preferred, adjacent and missing evidence
Every material claim preserves source, authority, contribution, confidence, confidentiality and limitations
Stories reveal actual context, task, reasoning, actions, result, guardrails, reflection and transfer
Impact, evidence, roles, hypotheses, controlled action, communication, recovery and learning remain distinct
Requirements, units, state, failure, security, operations, alternatives and evolution survive challenge
Several duration modes answer directly, remain ordered and preserve facts
Unfamiliar challenges and changed constraints produce transparent adaptation without invention
No prohibited disclosure, misrepresentation, unauthorized assistance or hiring prediction occurs
Weak claims are corrected and lessons change later reasoning rather than merely closing the story
A later differently ordered loop retains evidence quality without answer-key dependence
